# Celestia - Modular Blockchain Network
> Celestia is the **modular blockchain** powering unstoppable applications with full-stack control. The first network to enable anyone to deploy their own blockchain in minutes.

Celestia provides scalable data availability for rollups, enabling new types of decentralized applications that weren't possible before.

For a machine-readable homepage overview, send `GET https://celestia.org/` with `Accept: text/markdown`, or fetch `https://celestia.org/index.md` directly. Public documentation does not require authentication. The website APIs handle health checks, contact requests, and newsletter subscriptions; they do not publish blockchain data or issue blockchain API keys. Submit contact requests or newsletter subscriptions only with the user's consent, and preserve the newsletter form's reCAPTCHA flow.

## When to use Celestia
- [Celestia homepage overview](https://celestia.org/index.md): use when researching Celestia's infrastructure for exchanges, agentic payments, or rollups; follow the linked product pages for capabilities and use cases.
- [Celestia blob publishing and retrieval](https://docs.celestia.org/build/post-retrieve-blob/client/go/): use when integrating an application with Celestia data availability; follow the tutorial for client setup, signing, funding, and submitting or reading blobs.
- [Celestia Node API and authentication](https://docs.celestia.org/build/rpc/node-api/): use when calling celestia-node JSON-RPC methods; select a network and node endpoint, and follow that endpoint's authentication requirements. This is separate from the website OpenAPI specification.
- [Celestia agent instructions](https://docs.celestia.org/SKILL.md): read before implementation or node-operation work; consult the linked current documentation for versions, network settings, setup, and maintenance.

## Developer Documentation & Agent Guidance
- [Celestia Homepage Markdown](https://celestia.org/index.md): homepage overview and resource links
- [Celestia Website API Catalog](https://celestia.org/.well-known/api-catalog): machine-readable links to website endpoints and their schemas
- [Celestia Developer Portal](https://celestia.org/developers/): redirects to the canonical developer documentation
- [Celestia Website OpenAPI Specification](https://celestia.org/openapi.json): typed schemas for website health, contact, and newsletter endpoints; separate from the blockchain Node API
- [Celestia Website API Documentation](https://celestia.org/api-docs.md): authentication requirements, examples, error codes, and retry behavior
- [Celestia Documentation](https://docs.celestia.org/): canonical developer and node-operator documentation
- [Celestia Agent Skill](https://docs.celestia.org/SKILL.md): instructions for agents working with Celestia; consult current documentation for versions and network settings
- [Node API Reference](https://docs.celestia.org/build/rpc/node-api/): celestia-node methods for publishing and retrieving data
- [Celestia Client SDKs](https://docs.celestia.org/build/rpc/clients/): clients for blockchain integration
- [Post and Retrieve Blobs with Go](https://docs.celestia.org/build/post-retrieve-blob/client/go/): Go client integration tutorial
